**LEGAL NOTICE**

**By Registered Post AD / Speed Post**

**Date:** [VERIFY Date]

**To:**  
[Tenant's Full Name]  
[Tenant's Address, Pune, Maharashtra - PIN]

**From:**  
[Advocate's Name]  
[Advocate's Address/Chamber, Pune, Maharashtra]

---

### **NOTICE FOR RECOVERY OF UNPAID RENT ARREARS**

Sir/Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, [Landlord's Full Name], owner of Property No. [Insert Property Details/Address, Pune], I hereby give you notice to pay the outstanding rent arrears amounting to **Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only)** for the period [Insert Month/Period] within 15 days of receiving this notice, failing which my client shall be constrained to initiate appropriate civil and criminal legal proceedings against you for recovery of the said amount along with interest and litigation costs entirely at your risk and expense.


[Signature]  
**[Advocate's Name]**  
Advocate, High Court / District Court, Pune
